formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P8 — Frozen-Population Index-Covariate Recovery, Method-Family×Reconstructor-Frequency Support Geometry, Zero-Support Cell Accounting, Descriptive Post-Stratified Five-Rival Transport, Cross-Era Stability & Missing-Covariate Adversarial Bound Court

inputs.frozen_geometry: same 60 G7-P7 body solves and solve-level five-rival excess
inputs.new_contact: index pages only; no solve-body pages

coverage_gate.primary: report method and reconstructor nonempty coverage over the frozen 10,591 3x3 IDs
coverage_gate.partial_coverage_lane: either < 0.95; retain missing as explicit support class and activate the already-sealed 200-ID body-light manifest only as a missingness diagnostic, not as a replacement population
coverage_gate.live_missing_ids: explicit FROZEN_ID_NOT_LIVE; never replace with new live IDs

primary_readouts: population counts and shares on each support axis
60-body counts and shares on the same axes
descriptive post-stratified TS and H1 mean excess on method-family axis
descriptive post-stratified TS and H1 on reconstructor-frequency-band axis
descriptive post-stratified TS and H1 on method×reconstructor-band joint cells
secondary_readouts: difference from P7 provenance-only post-stratified results
weighting_law: descriptive population-share/sample-share factors only; never inverse-probability weights
renormalize post-stratified means over positive-sample-support population mass
missing method/reconstructor is retained as an explicit population class
new live IDs outside the frozen population contribute zero weight

adversarial_bound.apply_to: zero-sample-support population mass separately for each support axis
adversarial_bound.sign_rule: population lower bound > 0 identifies positive sign under full-range adversarial completion
adversarial_bound.magnitude_rule: sign identification does not identify missing-cell magnitude

adjudication: TS/H1 sign reversal after method or reconstructor adjustment => transport instability
same sign but material zero-support mass => supported-cell robustness with population-wide sign bound
same sign and adversarial lower bound > 0 => population sign robust on that support axis
raw reconstructor-label failure does not invalidate frequency-band transport if the band axis has positive support
no result identifies a human cognitive mechanism
